messages:
michelle_pm: Quick sync - ACME asked for an Optimize toolkit pilot that (1) reduces p99 without hurting median too much, (2) can recommend batching/cache/quantization per-route, and (3) emits eval-triggered alerts when quality regresses. Thoughts on minimal pilot scope?

rahul_eng: Minimal pilot = adaptive microbatching + per-route KV caching + int8 recommendation engine. Leave int4 and model surgery out. Need runtime flags and lightweight metrics first.

michelle_pm: Good. We should be explicit about "per-route". ACME will have two routes: user-facing chat (low latency) and background summarization (throughput).

alex_cs: They want the sampler to run on both routes, and for us to show cost delta. They can supply route-specific sample sets.

sara_ml: For eval-triggered alerts: propose ruleset that compares current model outputs vs baseline on customer corpus with metric buckets (exact_match, rouge_L, embedding_cosine). Alert when relative drop > X% and absolute magnitude > eps. Also include a latency check to avoid false positives from timeouts.

tim_sre: Ops constraints: pilot must be feature-flagged per-customer + per-route. Need canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and a global kill switch. Also require a diagnostics page in Console for batch_size distribution and cache effectiveness.

marco_infra: Runtime note: microbatching needs short max_wait_ms (5-25ms) for chat route. For background summarization we can bump max_wait_ms to 100-200ms and batch cap high. Also recommend a prefetch TTL for KV cache to reduce cold-starts.

rahul_eng: We can add a simple recommender that suggests config: {route_type: chat|batch, suggested_batch: 1-12, suggested_quant: none|int8, cache_pref: low|high}. Implementation: lightweight offline profiler + a small ML model or heuristics.

sara_ml: Heuristics ok for pilot. Prioritize explainability: show why we suggested int8 (e.g., eval delta < 1% and latency benefit > 10%).

michelle_pm: Launch acceptance checklist idea: 1) perf baseline vs pilot on staging for 72h; 2) automatic eval alerts firing behave as expected on synthetic regressions; 3) canary toggle works; 4) docs + SDK example.

jenna_product: I'll own the checklist and ACME coordination. Proposed timeline: 3 sprints (prototype, eval/alerts, docs + staging). Pilot gated after a 2-week customer soak.

alex_cs: ACME notes: they need auto-fallback to original model and opt-out per-route via API. Also request logs of sampled inputs for 24h retention for analysis.

tim_sre: Sampling pipeline OK but watch PII. Must integrate with our data-privacy sampling policy and obfuscation steps before storage.

marco_infra: CI note: adding microbatching changes kernel scheduling — I'll add a perf test that runs nightly on representative sequences.

ci-bot: Build queued: feature/optimize-recs -> staging (#7932)

rahul_eng: Proto config YAML (pilot):
```yaml
optimize_toolkit:
  enabled: true
  routes:
    - name: chat
      adaptive_batching: true
      max_wait_ms: 15
      max_batch_size: 8
      recommend_quant: int8
      cache_ttl_ms: 60000
    - name: summarization
      adaptive_batching: true
      max_wait_ms: 150
      max_batch_size: 64
      recommend_quant: int8
      cache_ttl_ms: 300000
  eval_alerts:
    enabled: true
    relative_drop_threshold: 0.02
    absolute_min_delta: 0.003
    sampling_rate_on_alert: 1.0
```

sara_ml: Proposed alert rule (pseudo):
```
on window(1h):
  for metric in [rouge_L, embedding_cosine]:
    if relative_drop(metric) > 0.02 and abs_drop(metric) > 0.005:
      emit_alert(tag="optimize_econ_regress")
```
We should default sampling_rate_on_alert to 100% for at least 30 minutes.

michelle_pm: Decision check: keep int8 in pilot, postpone int4 and model-specific quant tuning. Anyone object?

rahul_eng: Agree. int8 gives good perf/quality tradeoff and is safer for pilot.

alex_cs: ACME ok with int8 only.

tim_sre: Ops also prefer int8 first.

jenna_product: I'll update roadmap doc and add milestones: prototype perf (week1), eval hooks + alerts (week2), canary + fallback + docs (week3).

michelle_pm: Action items: rahul - bench chat vs summarization configs and produce per-route perf/cost table; sara - implement eval hooks + default thresholds; marco - add nightly perf test + sampling pipeline compliance; tim - canary controls + global kill; jenna - update PRD and runbook; alex - confirm ACME corpora and opt-out API format. Please ack here when done.
